system_description.narrative_title: Geopolitical Wars, Drone Escalation, and Global Energy Shock
system_description.narrative_summary: A surge in kinetic and hybrid conflict — chiefly Russia’s campaign in Ukraine and renewed U.S.–Iran/Middle East tensions — is disrupting energy flows and driving volatile oil markets while accelerating use of drones and attacks on critical infrastructure. These dynamics create reinforcing feedbacks: strikes and export disruptions lift prices and political pressures, which in turn shape military postures, sanctions, and corporate decisions, producing cascading economic and security impacts across regions. Defense measures, market responses, and diplomatic moves are tightly coupled and continuously reshaping risk perceptions and supply arrangements.
system_description.scope: Inside the system boundary: state and proxy military actions (Russia-Ukraine, Iran-linked tensions), hybrid attacks (drones, sabotage), global oil and gas production/export flows (pipelines, Hormuz, Red Sea), inventories and prices (SPR, markets), critical infrastructure targets (refineries, data centers, steel plants), defense technologies and countermeasures, major state actors and policy responses (NATO, U.S., Russia, Iran, Saudi Arabia, Ukraine), and corporate/economic reactions (production cuts, asset freezes).
system_description.super_system: The global geopolitical-economic system: international security architecture integrated with global energy markets and interdependent supply chains.
adjacent_subsystems: Global energy markets and commodity trading
European security architecture and NATO response mechanisms
U.S. domestic politics and foreign policy decision-making
Global supply chains and energy-dependent industries

variables.name: Kinetic Conflict Intensity
variables.description: Measures the overall intensity and scale of conventional and proxy military operations across the theater, including ground, air, and naval engagements.

variables.name: Hybrid Attack Rate
variables.description: Measures the rate at which hybrid operations (sabotage, cyber intrusions, irregular raids, and non-conventional strikes) occur over time.

variables.name: Drone Use Intensity
variables.description: Measures the prevalence, operational tempo, and lethality of unmanned aerial systems employed in offensive and support roles.

variables.name: Critical Infrastructure Disruption
variables.description: Measures the aggregate functional disruption to critical infrastructure sectors (energy, telecoms, transport, industrial) at a given time.

variables.name: Oil Export Flow
variables.description: Measures the volumetric flow rate of crude oil and refined product exports moving through global trade routes and terminals.

variables.name: Oil Price Level
variables.description: Measures the prevailing market price level for benchmark crude oil and major refined products.

variables.name: Emergency Oil Reserves
variables.description: Measures the aggregated stock level of emergency or strategic petroleum reserves available for release to markets.

variables.name: Supply Chain Disruption
variables.description: Measures the degree of interruption to logistics, manufacturing inputs, and cross-border supply chain continuity.

variables.name: Defense Deployment Level
variables.description: Measures the scale and concentration of deployed defensive assets and countermeasures (air defenses, patrols, escorts, cybersecurity) in contested areas.

variables.name: Sanctions and Trade Restriction Intensity
variables.description: Measures the breadth and severity of economic restrictions, asset controls, and trade barriers imposed across actors and sectors.

variables.name: Corporate Withdrawal Rate
variables.description: Measures the rate at which firms reduce exposure through divestments, production cuts, asset freezes, or relocation decisions.

variables.name: Market Volatility Level
variables.description: Measures short-term volatility and uncertainty in financial and commodity markets tied to geopolitical and supply shocks.

variables.name: Geopolitical Risk Perception
variables.description: Measures collective perceptions and expectations of political and security risk among market actors, policymakers, and publics.

variables.name: Energy Supply Resilience
variables.description: Measures the capacity of energy systems to absorb, redistribute, and recover from disruptions to production and transport.

variables.name: Chokepoint Vulnerability
variables.description: Measures the exposure and susceptibility of key maritime and transit chokepoints to interdiction, closure, or disruption.

variables.name: Defense Technology Adoption Rate
variables.description: Measures the pace at which countermeasures (counter-drone systems, hardened infrastructure, monitoring tech) are deployed and integrated.

catalysts.title: US–Iran talks remain stalled
catalysts.description: Ongoing stalemate in U.S.–Iran negotiations over Hormuz reopening and broader Iran proposals, keeping geopolitical risk and oil market tensions elevated.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Oil rebounds after Trump rejects Iran peace deal'; 'US-Iran talks face fresh hurdles'; 'Trump rejects Iranian proposal to reopen Hormuz Strait'.

catalysts.title: Sustained Russian drone strikes in Ukraine
catalysts.description: Continued Russian drone and jet-drone strikes against Ukrainian cities, industry and data centres, sustaining high operational tempo.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Russian drones hit Kyiv...'; 'Russian strikes shut Ukraine's biggest steelmaker'; 'Russia targets Ukraine’s data centres'.

catalysts.title: North Korea swarm-attack testing and diffusion
catalysts.description: North Korea's tests of mixed drone-and-missile swarm attacks increase risk of tactic diffusion and regional countermeasure demand.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'North Korea Is Testing Swarm Attacks Mixing Drones and Missiles'.

catalysts.title: U.S. meets Ukraine assistance deadline
catalysts.description: Imminent U.S. decision to meet a Ukraine assistance deadline, delivering security aid that could alter battlefield dynamics.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Exclusive: Trump administration to meet Ukraine assistance deadline'.

catalysts.title: Potential U.S. SPR release
catalysts.description: With U.S. SPR stocks at decades-low levels, a policy decision to release or refrain from releases will affect oil markets and reserves.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Oil stocks in US strategic petroleum reserve fall to lowest level since 1982'.

catalysts.title: Saudi export boost/resumption
catalysts.description: Saudi Arabia's resumed Red Sea shipments and higher crude exports continue to offset regional disruptions, affecting flows and prices.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Saudi Arabia Resumes Red Sea Oil Exports'; 'Mideast oil exports rebound... Saudi Arabia boosts shipments'.

catalysts.title: NATO/EU coordination on hybrid responses
catalysts.description: EU consideration of NATO-style joint responses and NATO calls for condemnation may produce coordinated measures against Russian hybrid attacks.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'EU countries consider Nato-style joint responses'; 'Top NATO commander urges states to condemn Russian acts of sabotage'.

catalysts.title: Kremlin pressures businesses; asset actions
catalysts.description: Kremlin pressure on firms to fund drone defences and administrative seizures (Metro) accelerates corporate risk decisions and local defensive spending.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Kremlin pressures Russian businesses to pay for drone defences'; 'Russia puts German retailer Metro's assets under temporary administration'.

catalysts.title: Pentagon-backed Venezuelan oil ramp-up
catalysts.description: A Pentagon-backed Venezuelan oil firm preparing to scale operations could add exports and partially counter Middle East supply shocks.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Pentagon-Backed Oil Company Is Set to Vie for Chevron’s Crown in Venezuela'; 'Pentagon-Backed Venezuelan Oil Company Poised to Challenge Chevron'.

catalysts.title: Continuation of Ukrainian eastern offensives
catalysts.description: Ukrainian advances in key eastern battlefields are likely to continue, affecting front-line intensity, infrastructure and defensive needs.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Ukrainian forces advance in key eastern battlefield'; 'An Exclusive Interview With Ukraine’s President Zelensky'.
